review: Drafted synthetically, then reviewed by the project owner in two comment rounds; every comment was resolved by a guideline rule or a label change (decisions below). Not certified by a medical or emergency-services domain expert.
owner_decisions: reporter_relation UNDER_REVIEW when the text points to the reporter's family or home but leaves open whether the reporter is among the victims; resolved after extraction by comparing caller position with the described location (F-1)
Water-level bands are half-open (a boundary value belongs to the deeper level); ranges use their upper end; the unit the report uses is applied without conversion
'For N hours' is a hazard duration (V2 precedent); explicitly elapsed time ('since', 'ago') is not
CHRONIC_CARE covers known long-term conditions without an acute episode; an acute episode takes only the acute category
Urgency rule: a low-mobility group with water at or above WAIST and RISING is CRITICAL
Gold urgency: a critical symptom resolved within 24 hours is URGENT; a resolved minor injury alone gives no urgency
dev_set_separation: No input text or victim_location is shared with triage-eval-v3-dev-candidates. Some scenario types (e.g. snakebite, labour, insulin) appear in both sets with different wording and places.
